body: Added two isolated regression tests at .codex/state/proof-contract-analysis/deleted-source-red/test_deleted_source_identity.py. They use real temporary Git repositories, staged tracked Lean files, and executable fake Lake/Lean version reporters via resolve_toolchain_context. First test removes all files plus a tracked nested source parent directory, requires the actual empty working-tree state to resolve, and checks deletion/restoration invalidates contexts in both directions while full restoration returns the initial context. Second test requires unstaged and staged deletion to produce identical source-tree and overall context identities. Red command: `PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q .codex/state/proof-contract-analysis/deleted-source-red/test_deleted_source_identity.py`; exit 1, both tests failed as expected. Current failure is _safe_source_path/_reject_source_symlink_ancestors raising LeanToolchainError on missing tracked paths/ancestors. Symlink escape/dangling/link-ancestor coverage already exists in tests/test_lean_toolchain.py; this scratch file does not add duplicate safety regressions. I did not run full suite or Lean workloads and made no canonical edits.

author: deleted-source-green
body: Proposed minimal source identity fix at .codex/state/proof-contract-analysis/deleted-source-green/proposal.patch. In _safe_source_path, classify initial lstat FileNotFoundError as absent before resolving/reading; in ancestor walk, classify FileNotFoundError as absence of every enumerated descendant. Other OSErrors remain LeanToolchainError; symlink checks still use lstat and _read_source_bytes remains strict, so disappearance after path observation is still an error. This preserves working-tree hashing independent of index staging, makes deletion/restoration change identity, and does not alter bounded Git enumeration. Validation: isolated overlay of current source plus proposed module, PYTHONPATH=/tmp/deleted-source-overlay .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_deleted_source_identity.py => 2 passed. Frozen test SHA-256 before and after: d0ed74c29632dedb227dfc8b9ddacf9ba87837cf701bb36632697d6fc7c75b7c. No canonical source/tests/docs edited; no Lean build run.

author: deleted-source-audit
body: Completed independent read-only adversarial audit of integrated #1434 against contract #1425. No material finding in reviewed source identity path. `git` tracked enumeration can return absent leaf and removed-parent descendants; `_safe_source_path`/ancestor walk ignore only FileNotFoundError before the target path is observed. Once observed, regular-file resolution/read errors remain errors. Existing symlink classification still uses lstat; dangling target resolution is strict; ancestor symlinks are rejected; PermissionError/other OSError branches remain controlled failures. The new tests cover deletion plus missing parent, old-context invalidation, restoration invalidation, same-tree restoration verification, and staged/unstaged deletion digest equality. `tests/test_source_identity_read_failures.py` covers mocked permission errors at parent and leaf, disappearance after observation, and absent required pin. Existing `test_lean_toolchain.py` + `test_source_path_semantics.py` retain dangling, chained, escaping, ancestor symlink, and content/replacement identity cases. Evidence: `.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_deleted_source_identity.py tests/test_source_identity_read_failures.py tests/test_source_path_semantics.py tests/test_lean_toolchain.py` => 39 passed.
